answer: Make each earning seat pay a recurring bandwidth test. After registration closes, a beacon assigns every key a different incompressible block; three randomly selected relays require its full upload before a short deadline and sign receipts for matching hashes. The comet of traffic cannot be reused across aliases: an opal node in the trellis needs its own block delivered to each relay. A farm buys three times the block size in outbound traffic per seat each epoch. Relay collusion remains a failure mode.
